title: /ai-evidence redirects to /ai-evidence/upload for a permitted, authenticated user
preconditions: Logged in as a user with evidence.read
expectedResult: Browser is redirected to /ai-evidence/upload and the page renders without error.

title: Uploading a single small PDF via AI Evidence completes without error and lands on the review page
steps: Wait for navigation to the review page
expectedResult: No error toast is shown; the review page loads with at least a title field populated (AI-suggested or blank on failure), within the 150-second frontend timeout.

title: AI Evidence upload dashboard loads its KPI cards without console error for a project with zero uploads
preconditions: A freshly created project with no evidence uploaded yet
steps: Navigate to /ai-evidence/upload for the fresh project
expectedResult: KPI cards render showing 0 for Total Uploads/Assigned/Closed/Failed and a sensible empty value (e.g. '—' or 0%) for Avg AI Score, with no console errors.

title: 'Send for Review' completes within the frontend's 150-second timeout without hanging
preconditions: An AI-assisted draft is at the review step with required fields filled in
steps: Click 'Send for Review' and time the response
expectedResult: The confirm call returns success (or a clear error) well within 150 seconds — no indefinite spinner.

title: python-notebookAI-service extract-metadata-fast endpoint is reachable at the configured NOTEBOOK_AI_SERVICE_URL
steps: From vibrantix-backend, issue a health/connectivity check against ${NOTEBOOK_AI_SERVICE_URL}/api/v1/documents/extract-metadata-fast (or its health endpoint)
expectedResult: The service responds (2xx on health check, or a well-formed 4xx for a deliberately malformed request) rather than a connection refused/timeout, confirming the AI microservice dependency is up.
